title: Muddy Color Is Not a Saturation Problem. It Is a Separation Problem
excerpt: Pushing saturation feels like the fastest route to vivid color, and it usually makes the photo flatter. Vivid comes from colors separated enough to do different jobs.

title: He Photographed Leeds Between Delivery Drops. That City Is Gone Now
excerpt: Peter Mitchell shot Leeds shopkeepers, cafes, and terraced streets between delivery drops in the 1970s. The city in his pictures has vanished. Yours is changing too.

title: The Nikon D850 Is End of Life. That Does Not Make It Dead
excerpt: Nikon UK has told retailers the D850 is end of life and no more stock is coming. In the US it is still on sale, discounted. End of life is a supply phrase, not a verdict on the camera.
